statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The denial reason code is PR-204
The patient has recurrent syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atrial fibrillation
There is concern for intermittent high-grade conduction disease or tachy-brady syndrome
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to guide further management of rate control and anticoagulation therapy
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
